hook: SidePulse Dot: a tiny USB-C light
hookText: SidePulse Dot: a tiny USB-C light

beats.say: Peter Kuhar's SidePulse Dot is a 3D-printed USB-C plug with two programmable RGB LEDs that shows whether Claude or Codex agents are working, need input or are done, on a Mac.
On an iPhone, the CLI sends an animation as a push notification to the SidePulse app, which forwards it to the Dot over USB-C.
It costs $29, discounted to $19.72 for Black Friday, and is a first batch for enthusiasts; a larger 8-LED SidePulse Pro fits the MacBook Pro SD slot.
